scripts.build: npm run build -w @tldr/astro-knowledge && npm run build -w @tldr/web
scripts.test: npm run test:content && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.test:content: node scripts/test-authored-verbatim-rendering.mjs && node scripts/test-authored-placement-coverage.mjs && node scripts/test-placement-scaffold-rendering.mjs && node scripts/test-authored-sky-placement-coverage.mjs && node scripts/test-reader-facing-content-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-reader-fallback-surface-safety.mjs && node scripts/test-sky-placement-regressions.mjs && node scripts/test-web-api-house-parity.mjs && node scripts/test-fallback-wiring-and-phrasebook.mjs
scripts.qa:client-flows: playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/visual/client-facing-user-flows.spec.ts --grep-invert "content fallback copy|directional copy"
scripts.qa:content-copy: playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/visual/client-facing-user-flows.spec.ts -g "content fallback copy|directional copy"
